preconditions.description: The number of packages n must be between 1 and 1000.
Each package name must be a string of up to 40 non-whitespace characters.
Each package can have at most 20 dependencies.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'cannot be ordered' if any(cycle in dependencies for cycle in package_dependencies) else True
postconditions.description: If there is a cycle in dependencies, output 'cannot be ordered'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '\n'.join(sorted(packages)) if all(dependency in installed for dependency in dependencies) else True
postconditions.description: Output the lexicographically first order of installation if all dependencies are satisfied.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '\n'.join(sorted(packages)) if all(dependency in installed for dependency in dependencies) else True
postconditions.description: Ensure that the output order respects the dependencies of each package.
